import sys, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from syntax import parse_policy
import ebpf.create_dfa as cd
names = ['S%d'%i for i in range(4)]

rules,a,p = parse_policy(pol)
print('atoms',a,'paths',p)
acc, rows, cells = cd.image(rules, order, idx)
print('rows', len(rows), 'cells', cells, acc)
PYEOF
